caseName: Dunn v. County of Los Angeles
caseNameFull: DUNN Et Al. v. COUNTY OF LOS ANGELES Et Al.
attorneys: Henry W. Robinson for appellants., Harold W. Kennedy for the County of Los Angeles, appellee., Roger J. Whiteford, John J. Wilson, Oscar John Dorwin and Ray A. Pittman, Jr., for the Texas Company, appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

The motions to dismiss are granted and the appeal is dismissed. Treating the papers whereon the appeal was taken as a petition for writ of certiorari, certiorari is denied.
